title: Bit-Exact Reproducibility Given Same Initial State and Inputs
body: Given the same initial emulator state, ROM set, mounted media, inputs, and timing model, managed C64 PAL execution must produce deterministic CPU, bus, video, audio, interrupt, and memory-observable results.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Lockstep and checkpoint suites continue to pass after performance optimizations.
Optimizations do not change public observable machine state signatures or behavior contracts.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: PR #3 keeps public API signatures stable and correctness gates green
